description: Implementation of the Device.WiFi.Radio.Stats API, including functions to retrieve WiFi radio statistics such as bytes sent/received, packet counts, errors, and noise floor, with external dependencies on WiFi management interfaces and internal instance management.

classes.name: hostIf_WiFi_Radio_Stats
classes.description: Class managing WiFi radio statistics, including instance management, data retrieval, and external interface interactions.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an instance of hostIf_WiFi_Radio_Stats for a given device ID.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_Props_Fields
methods.description: Fetches WiFi radio properties via IARM bus call and updates internal statistics.

methods.name: checkWifiRadioPropsFetch
methods.description: Checks if it's time to refresh WiFi radio properties based on a query interval.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_BytesSent
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes sent over WiFi radio.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_BytesReceived
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes received over WiFi radio.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_PacketsSent
methods.description: Returns the count of packets sent.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_PacketsReceived
methods.description: Returns the count of packets received.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_ErrorsSent
methods.description: Returns the number of errors during sending.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_ErrorsReceived
methods.description: Returns the number of errors during receiving.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_DiscardPacketsSent
methods.description: Returns the count of discarded packets during sending.

methods.name: get_Device_WiFi_Radio_Stats_DiscardPacketsReceived
methods.description: Returns the count of discarded packets during receiving.
